### Topics

- **The ekayāna 一乘 doctrine and *kāiquán xiǎnshí* 開權顯實.** The proclamation in chapters 2–9 of the Lotus that the *śrāvaka* / *pratyekabuddha* / *bodhisattva* three vehicles are provisional (*quán* 權) and the Buddha-vehicle alone is real (*shí* 實) is the central scriptural commitment around which the entire Tiāntái doctrinal apparatus is built, and almost every Sinitic Lotus exegete from Fǎyún onward addresses its hermeneutic status.
- **The *jìmén* / *běnmén* 跡門／本門 division.** The split of the Lotus into a "trace-gate" (chapters 1–14) and an "origin-gate" (15–28) is associated with Dàoxuān's preface to Kumārajīva ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)) and given systematic articulation in Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006); it remains the standard Sinitic exegetical schema through the entire division.
- **The *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.** Zhìyǐ's chronological-and-modal organisation of the Buddha's *kerygma* into five periods (*Huāyán*, *Lùyuàn / Āhán*, *Fāngděng*, *Bōrě*, *Fǎhuá-Nièpán*) and eight modes is developed in the *Xuányì*, summarised in [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and [KR6d0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0167), and given canonical compact form in Chégwan's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168); it is the basic doctrinal-classification apparatus of the division.
- **Tiāntái meditation: *yīxīn sānguān* 一心三觀, *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千, *zhǐguān bùèr* 止觀不二.** Articulated principally in the *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) and its commentaries; the most systematic Mahāyāna meditation theory in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- **The *shānjiā / shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy.** The 11th-century Sòng-period split between Zhīlǐ's [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) "mountain-house" *shānjiā* — defending the Tiāntái doctrine of evil in the Buddha-nature (*xìng-è* 性惡) and Guàndǐng's role in the early canon — and the *shānwài* counter-position of Yuánqīng 源清, Zhìyuán 智圓, and (later) Rényuè 仁岳, particularly over the interpretation of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the status of Guàndǐng's *Guānyīn xuányì* commentary [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046). The dispute generated the large mid-Sòng polemical literature visible in [KR6d0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0184)–[KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) and [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)–[KR6d0235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0235).
- **Buddha-nature in the insentient (*wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性).** Zhànrán's claim in the *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) that even insentient things possess Buddha-nature; the Tiāntái counter-position to the Chán and Huāyán readings on the same question, generating the *Jīngāngbēi*-commentary sub-tradition ([KR6d0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0176)–[KR6d0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0181)).
- **The Lotus liturgy: *Fǎhuá sānmèi* 法華三昧 and the *chànyí* tradition.** Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi practice from the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) is the textual base for a Sòng-period ritual literature, principally elaborated by Zūnshì and Zhīlǐ, that fed back into ordinary monastic and lay practice and shaped the late-imperial Tiāntái devotional landscape.
- **The Guānyīn 觀音 sub-cult.** The detachment of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 (Lotus chapter 25) as an independent devotional unit, with its own commentarial corpus ([KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046)–[KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057)) — Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and *yìshū* and their Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentaries — is one of the principal vehicles by which the Lotus's textual presence extended into popular ritual practice.
- **Japanese Lotus reception: Tendai 天台 and Shingon 真言 readings.** The Heian-period esoteric / *mìjiào* interpretations of the Lotus by Kūkai 空海 ([KR6d0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0036)–[KR6d0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0044)) and the early Japanese Tendai materials (e.g. [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)) constitute a distinct Lotus reading transmitted within the same division.
- **The Míng–Qīng Tiāntái revival.** Zhìxù's [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) 17th-century systematisation, the Qīng-period Tiāntái commentaries by Língyào, Tōnglǐ, and others ([KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084)–[KR6d0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0098), [KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142)), and the late-imperial *Sìjiào yí* sub-commentaries ([KR6d0169](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0169)–[KR6d0174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0174)) constitute the final phase of pre-modern Lotus scholarship represented in the division.

## Division note: [KR6d 法華部 *Fǎhuá bù* — Buddhist Canon — Saddharmapuṇḍarīka (Lotus) Section](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/)

### Scope and scholarly tradition

`KR6d` corresponds to the *Fǎhuá bù* 法華部 of the Taishō structural ordering — the Lotus Sūtra and its satellite scriptures in Taishō volume 9, the Lotus sub-commentary tradition in Taishō volumes 26 and 33–34, the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal-and-meditation corpus in Taishō volume 46, the Lotus Dūnhuáng 敦煌 fragments in volume 85, and the very large Sòng–Qīng manuscript continuation of all these strands preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏經. In Wilkinson's outline of the Taishō (§29.5.8), volume 9 is identified as "*Fǎhuá bù* (Lotus and other Mahāyāna sūtras)"; Kanripo's `KR6d` extends that vol. 9 nucleus outward to absorb all Chinese-language Lotus commentary and the entire Tiāntái scholastic apparatus that grows out of it, because in East-Asian classification the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal tradition — including its meditation manuals, doctrinal-classification literature, and ritual / *chànyí* 懺儀 works — is canonically attached to the Lotus Sūtra rather than treated as an independent *zōng* 宗 section.

The principal scholarly tradition organising the division is therefore Tiāntái, whose founder Zhìyǐ 智顗 (538–597) was traditionally regarded as the patriarch and whose 593–597 lectures at Yùquánsì 玉泉寺, redacted by Guàndǐng 灌頂 (561–632), produced the *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 ("Three Great Treatises of Tiāntái") — *Fǎhuá xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006), *Fǎhuá wénjù* [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014), and *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — around which most of the division is structured (Wilkinson §29.5.7.1 on Tiāntái; Hurvitz 1963 on Zhìyǐ; Lopez 2016 and Teiser & Stone 2009 on the Lotus Sūtra). Pre-Tiāntái Liáng exegesis (Fǎyún 法雲), the early Suí Sānlùn 三論 reading by Jízàng 吉藏, and the Táng Faxiang 法相 / Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading by Kuījī 窺基 are also represented; from the 8th century onward the division is dominated by Zhànrán 湛然 (711–782) and his Sòng-period successors of the Tiāntái revival, and from the 11th century by the long *shānjiā* / *shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy and its literature. The division extends through Yuán, Míng (with the Tiāntái revival under Zhìxù 智旭 1599–1655), and Qīng (under Língyào 靈耀 and Tōnglǐ 通理) to roughly the mid-18th century.

### Important texts and text clusters

The 249 per-text notes in `kb/KR6d/` organise into five recognisable clusters.

#### The Lotus Sūtra itself and its parallel translations

- *Zhèng fǎhuá jīng* 正法華經 [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002) — Dharmarakṣa's 竺法護 translation of 286 CE, the earliest complete Chinese Lotus, surviving in 10 *juan*.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001) — Kumārajīva's 鳩摩羅什 translation of 406 CE, the dominant East-Asian recension in 7 *juan* and 28 chapters; the literary base for virtually all subsequent Lotus exegesis in Chinese.
- *Tiānpǐn miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 添品妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003) — the Suí (601) collation by Jñānagupta 闍那崛多 and Dharmagupta 笈多, incorporating the *Devadatta* chapter and the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 verses.
- *Sàtán fēntuólì jīng* 薩曇分陀利經 [KR6d0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0004) — a Western Jìn anonymous partial translation of the *Devadatta* episode, preserving a textual stratum independent of the three full versions.

#### Satellite Lotus-cycle sūtras (vol. 9)

- *Wúliàng yì jīng* 無量義經 [KR6d0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0118) — the Liáng-period "Sūtra of Innumerable Meanings," traditionally the prologue of the East-Asian "Threefold Lotus" 法華三部經.
- *Fóshuō Guān Pǔxián púsà xíngfǎ jīng* 佛說觀普賢菩薩行法經 [KR6d0120](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0120) — the Liú-Sòng-period "Sūtra of the Contemplation of Samantabhadra's Practice," the epilogue of the same triad.
- *Fóshuō fǎhuá sānmèi jīng* 佛說法華三昧經 [KR6d0108](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0108), *Bùtuìzhuǎn fǎlún jīng* 不退轉法輪經 [KR6d0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0106), *Dà fǎgǔ jīng* 大法鼓經 [KR6d0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0109), *Dà sàzhē Nígānzǐ suǒshuō jīng* 大薩遮尼乾子所說經 [KR6d0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0111) — Mahāyāna sūtras grouped with the Lotus on doctrinal and thematic grounds (one-vehicle teaching, irreversibility, the Tathāgata's hidden lifespan).

#### The *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 and their commentaries

- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng xuányì* 妙法蓮華經玄義 [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006) — Zhìyǐ's 593 Yùquánsì lectures on the doctrinal meaning of the Lotus, recorded by Guàndǐng; the foundational systematic theology of Tiāntái, source for the *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng wénjù* 妙法蓮華經文句 [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014) — Zhìyǐ's 587 phrase-by-phrase commentary on Kumārajīva's Lotus, recorded by Guàndǐng; pairs with the *Xuányì* as the doctrinal-plus-textual exegetical core.
- *Móhē zhǐguān* 摩訶止觀 [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — Zhìyǐ's 594 lectures on Tiāntái meditation, recorded by Guàndǐng; the most systematic *śamatha-vipaśyanā* manual in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- *Fǎhuá xuányì shìqiān* 法華玄義釋籤 [KR6d0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0007), *Fǎhuá wénjù jì* 法華文句記 [KR6d0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0015), and *Zhǐguān fǔxíng zhuànhóngjué* 止觀輔行傳弘決 [KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131) — Zhànrán's 湛然 (711–782) standard sub-commentaries on each member of the *sāndàbù*; the principal textual base of the Sòng Tiāntái revival.

#### Alternative Lotus-commentary traditions

- *Fǎhuá jīng yìjì* 法華經義記 [KR6d0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0005) — Fǎyún's 法雲 Liáng-period exegesis, the principal southern pre-Tiāntái reading and the polemical target of Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì*.
- *Fǎhuá xuánlùn* 法華玄論 [KR6d0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0023), *Fǎhuá yìshū* 法華義疏 [KR6d0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0024), *Fǎhuá yóuyì* 法華遊意 [KR6d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0025) — Jízàng's 吉藏 (549–623) Sānlùn 三論-school readings, doctrinally distinct from Tiāntái.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng xuánzàn* 妙法蓮華經玄贊 [KR6d0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0026) — Kuījī's 窺基 (632–682) Cí'ēn 慈恩 / Yogācāra reading of the Lotus, the principal Faxiang interpretation.
- *Fǎhuá zōngyào* 法華宗要 [KR6d0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0032) — the Sillan master Wǒnhyo's 元曉 short doctrinal synthesis, an important East-Asian non-Chinese voice.

#### Tiāntái doctrinal, meditation, and ritual literature (vol. 46)

- *Sìjiào yì* 四教義 [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* 天台四教儀 [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168) — Zhìyǐ's and the late-Táng / Korean Chégwan 諦觀's expositions of the four doctrinal teachings, the most-studied Tiāntái catechetical works.
- *Shí bùèr mén* 十不二門 [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the very large body of commentary it provoked (e.g. *Shí bùèr mén zhǐyào chāo* [KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158) by Zhīlǐ 知禮) — Zhànrán's 10-fold non-duality scheme, the textual flashpoint of the *shānjiā / shānwài* controversy.
- *Jīngāngbēi* 金剛錍 [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) — Zhànrán's polemical defense of *wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性 (Buddha-nature in insentient things), generative of a sub-commentary tradition into the Sòng.
- *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* 法華三昧懺儀 [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) and the related *chànyí* / *xíngfǎ* corpus — Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi liturgy and its Sòng elaborations (Zūnshì 遵式, Zhīlǐ 知禮), the principal Tiāntái ritual texts.
- *Sìmíng zūnzhě jiàoxíng lù* 四明尊者教行錄 [KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) — Zōngxiǎo's 宗曉 collected works of Zhīlǐ, the textual monument of the Sòng *shānjiā* school.
- *Jiàoguān gāngzōng* 教觀綱宗 [KR6d0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0188) — Zhìxù's 智旭 (1599–1655) Míng-period summary of Tiāntái doctrine, the principal late-imperial textbook.

### Important persons

- [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) — translator of the standard Lotus recension (T262 = [KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)); the literary register of his translation supplied the canonical Sinitic vocabulary of all subsequent Lotus exegesis in this division.
- [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) — translator of the earliest complete Chinese Lotus (T263 = [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002), 286) and of several satellite vol. 9 sūtras; his Lotus survives as the principal philological witness independent of Kumārajīva.
- [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) — co-translator with Dharmagupta 笈多 of the Suí Lotus recension (T264 = [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003), 601), source of the textual additions to the received Kumārajīva Lotus.
- [法雲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E9%9B%B2) — Liáng-period exegete of the Lotus ([KR6d0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0005)); the standard pre-Tiāntái southern reading, against which Zhìyǐ defined his own system.
- [慧思](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%80%9D) — Tiāntái second patriarch and Zhìyǐ's teacher; author of the *Fǎhuá jīng ānlèxíng yì* [KR6d0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0156) and other proto-Tiāntái Lotus-meditation works.
- [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) — third Tiāntái patriarch and de facto founder of Chinese Tiāntái doctrine; lecturer of the *sāndàbù* and dozens of other works in this division (the most-cited person in `KR6d`, named in ≈ 25 per-text notes).
- [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) — Zhìyǐ's principal disciple and the redactor / co-author of nearly the entire Zhìyǐ corpus; also author of the *Guóqīng bǎilù* [KR6d0183](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0183), the documentary record of the early Tiāntái community.
- [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) — Sānlùn master whose Lotus commentaries ([KR6d0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0023)–[KR6d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0025), [KR6d0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0128)) represent the principal alternative early-Suí exegetical line.
- [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) — Cí'ēn / Faxiang master who gave the Lotus a Yogācāra reading ([KR6d0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0026)); the source of the *xuánzàn* sub-commentary tradition.
- [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) — sixth Tiāntái patriarch and reviver of the school in the mid-Táng; author of the canonical sub-commentaries on the *sāndàbù* ([KR6d0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0007), [KR6d0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0015), [KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131)) and of the doctrinally generative *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175).
- [空海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A9%BA%E6%B5%B7) — founder of Japanese Shingon and author of seven Lotus-related Heian works in this division (e.g. [KR6d0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0036)–[KR6d0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0042)), giving the Lotus its esoteric / *mìjiào* 密教 reading.
- [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) — leader of the Sòng *shānjiā* 山家 branch of Tiāntái and the dominant figure of the 11th-century revival; the second-most-cited person in `KR6d` (≈ 11 notes), with the *Shí bùèr mén zhǐyào chāo* [KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158) and his liturgical *xíngfǎ* corpus.
- [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) — Zhīlǐ's contemporary and the principal Sòng ritual compiler; author of Tiāntái *chànyí* and devotional works (e.g. [KR6d0195](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0195), [KR6d0199](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0199)).
- [仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3) — Zhīlǐ's disciple who later turned to the *shānwài* 山外 position; author of the *Sìmíng Rényuè yìshuō cóngshū* [KR6d0224](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0224), the principal *shānwài* counter-statement.
- [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) — late-Sòng commentator on the *Móhē zhǐguān* and *Shí bùèr mén* whose works ([KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139)–[KR6d0141](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0141)) preserve the post-Zhīlǐ scholastic apparatus.
- [宗曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9B%89) — Sòng compiler of the *Sìmíng zūnzhě jiàoxíng lù* [KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186), the corpus of Zhīlǐ's writings; principal documentary editor of *shānjiā* Tiāntái.
- [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) — Míng-period reviver of Tiāntái and author of the *Jiàoguān gāngzōng* [KR6d0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0188); the principal late-imperial systematiser whose works re-frame Tiāntái for the Míng-Qīng setting.
- [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) — Qīng-period Tiāntái commentator on the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *sāndàbù* ([KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142) and related); his work is the principal Qīng Tiāntái scholastic continuation.

### Topics

- **The ekayāna 一乘 doctrine and *kāiquán xiǎnshí* 開權顯實.** The proclamation in chapters 2–9 of the Lotus that the *śrāvaka* / *pratyekabuddha* / *bodhisattva* three vehicles are provisional (*quán* 權) and the Buddha-vehicle alone is real (*shí* 實) is the central scriptural commitment around which the entire Tiāntái doctrinal apparatus is built, and almost every Sinitic Lotus exegete from Fǎyún onward addresses its hermeneutic status.
- **The *jìmén* / *běnmén* 跡門／本門 division.** The split of the Lotus into a "trace-gate" (chapters 1–14) and an "origin-gate" (15–28) is associated with Dàoxuān's preface to Kumārajīva ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)) and given systematic articulation in Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006); it remains the standard Sinitic exegetical schema through the entire division.
- **The *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.** Zhìyǐ's chronological-and-modal organisation of the Buddha's *kerygma* into five periods (*Huāyán*, *Lùyuàn / Āhán*, *Fāngděng*, *Bōrě*, *Fǎhuá-Nièpán*) and eight modes is developed in the *Xuányì*, summarised in [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and [KR6d0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0167), and given canonical compact form in Chégwan's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168); it is the basic doctrinal-classification apparatus of the division.
- **Tiāntái meditation: *yīxīn sānguān* 一心三觀, *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千, *zhǐguān bùèr* 止觀不二.** Articulated principally in the *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) and its commentaries; the most systematic Mahāyāna meditation theory in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- **The *shānjiā / shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy.** The 11th-century Sòng-period split between Zhīlǐ's [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) "mountain-house" *shānjiā* — defending the Tiāntái doctrine of evil in the Buddha-nature (*xìng-è* 性惡) and Guàndǐng's role in the early canon — and the *shānwài* counter-position of Yuánqīng 源清, Zhìyuán 智圓, and (later) Rényuè 仁岳, particularly over the interpretation of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the status of Guàndǐng's *Guānyīn xuányì* commentary [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046). The dispute generated the large mid-Sòng polemical literature visible in [KR6d0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0184)–[KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) and [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)–[KR6d0235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0235).
- **Buddha-nature in the insentient (*wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性).** Zhànrán's claim in the *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) that even insentient things possess Buddha-nature; the Tiāntái counter-position to the Chán and Huāyán readings on the same question, generating the *Jīngāngbēi*-commentary sub-tradition ([KR6d0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0176)–[KR6d0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0181)).
- **The Lotus liturgy: *Fǎhuá sānmèi* 法華三昧 and the *chànyí* tradition.** Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi practice from the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) is the textual base for a Sòng-period ritual literature, principally elaborated by Zūnshì and Zhīlǐ, that fed back into ordinary monastic and lay practice and shaped the late-imperial Tiāntái devotional landscape.
- **The Guānyīn 觀音 sub-cult.** The detachment of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 (Lotus chapter 25) as an independent devotional unit, with its own commentarial corpus ([KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046)–[KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057)) — Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and *yìshū* and their Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentaries — is one of the principal vehicles by which the Lotus's textual presence extended into popular ritual practice.

## Division note: [KR6d 法華部 *Fǎhuá bù* — Buddhist Canon — Saddharmapuṇḍarīka (Lotus) Section](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/)

### Scope and scholarly tradition

`KR6d` corresponds to the *Fǎhuá bù* 法華部 of the Taishō structural ordering — the Lotus Sūtra and its satellite scriptures in Taishō volume 9, the Lotus sub-commentary tradition in Taishō volumes 26 and 33–34, the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal-and-meditation corpus in Taishō volume 46, the Lotus Dūnhuáng 敦煌 fragments in volume 85, and the very large Sòng–Qīng manuscript continuation of all these strands preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏經. In Wilkinson's outline of the Taishō (§29.5.8), volume 9 is identified as "*Fǎhuá bù* (Lotus and other Mahāyāna sūtras)"; Kanripo's `KR6d` extends that vol. 9 nucleus outward to absorb all Chinese-language Lotus commentary and the entire Tiāntái scholastic apparatus that grows out of it, because in East-Asian classification the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal tradition — including its meditation manuals, doctrinal-classification literature, and ritual / *chànyí* 懺儀 works — is canonically attached to the Lotus Sūtra rather than treated as an independent *zōng* 宗 section.

The principal scholarly tradition organising the division is therefore Tiāntái, whose founder Zhìyǐ 智顗 (538–597) was traditionally regarded as the patriarch and whose 593–597 lectures at Yùquánsì 玉泉寺, redacted by Guàndǐng 灌頂 (561–632), produced the *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 ("Three Great Treatises of Tiāntái") — *Fǎhuá xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006), *Fǎhuá wénjù* [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014), and *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — around which most of the division is structured (Wilkinson §29.5.7.1 on Tiāntái; Hurvitz 1963 on Zhìyǐ; Lopez 2016 and Teiser & Stone 2009 on the Lotus Sūtra). Pre-Tiāntái Liáng exegesis (Fǎyún 法雲), the early Suí Sānlùn 三論 reading by Jízàng 吉藏, and the Táng Faxiang 法相 / Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading by Kuījī 窺基 are also represented; from the 8th century onward the division is dominated by Zhànrán 湛然 (711–782) and his Sòng-period successors of the Tiāntái revival, and from the 11th century by the long *shānjiā* / *shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy and its literature. The division extends through Yuán, Míng (with the Tiāntái revival under Zhìxù 智旭 1599–1655), and Qīng (under Língyào 靈耀 and Tōnglǐ 通理) to roughly the mid-18th century.

#### The Lotus Sūtra itself and its parallel translations

- *Zhèng fǎhuá jīng* 正法華經 [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002) — Dharmarakṣa's 竺法護 translation of 286 CE, the earliest complete Chinese Lotus, surviving in 10 *juan*.

- *Tiānpǐn miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 添品妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003) — the Suí (601) collation by Jñānagupta 闍那崛多 and Dharmagupta 笈多, incorporating the *Devadatta* chapter and the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 verses.
- *Sàtán fēntuólì jīng* 薩曇分陀利經 [KR6d0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0004) — a Western Jìn anonymous partial translation of the *Devadatta* episode, preserving a textual stratum independent of the three full versions.

### Topics

- **The ekayāna 一乘 doctrine and *kāiquán xiǎnshí* 開權顯實.** The proclamation in chapters 2–9 of the Lotus that the *śrāvaka* / *pratyekabuddha* / *bodhisattva* three vehicles are provisional (*quán* 權) and the Buddha-vehicle alone is real (*shí* 實) is the central scriptural commitment around which the entire Tiāntái doctrinal apparatus is built, and almost every Sinitic Lotus exegete from Fǎyún onward addresses its hermeneutic status.
- **The *jìmén* / *běnmén* 跡門／本門 division.** The split of the Lotus into a "trace-gate" (chapters 1–14) and an "origin-gate" (15–28) is associated with Dàoxuān's preface to Kumārajīva ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)) and given systematic articulation in Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006); it remains the standard Sinitic exegetical schema through the entire division.
- **The *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.** Zhìyǐ's chronological-and-modal organisation of the Buddha's *kerygma* into five periods (*Huāyán*, *Lùyuàn / Āhán*, *Fāngděng*, *Bōrě*, *Fǎhuá-Nièpán*) and eight modes is developed in the *Xuányì*, summarised in [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and [KR6d0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0167), and given canonical compact form in Chégwan's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168); it is the basic doctrinal-classification apparatus of the division.
- **Tiāntái meditation: *yīxīn sānguān* 一心三觀, *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千, *zhǐguān bùèr* 止觀不二.** Articulated principally in the *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) and its commentaries; the most systematic Mahāyāna meditation theory in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- **The *shānjiā / shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy.** The 11th-century Sòng-period split between Zhīlǐ's [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) "mountain-house" *shānjiā* — defending the Tiāntái doctrine of evil in the Buddha-nature (*xìng-è* 性惡) and Guàndǐng's role in the early canon — and the *shānwài* counter-position of Yuánqīng 源清, Zhìyuán 智圓, and (later) Rényuè 仁岳, particularly over the interpretation of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the status of Guàndǐng's *Guānyīn xuányì* commentary [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046). The dispute generated the large mid-Sòng polemical literature visible in [KR6d0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0184)–[KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) and [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)–[KR6d0235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0235).
- **Buddha-nature in the insentient (*wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性).** Zhànrán's claim in the *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) that even insentient things possess Buddha-nature; the Tiāntái counter-position to the Chán and Huāyán readings on the same question, generating the *Jīngāngbēi*-commentary sub-tradition ([KR6d0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0176)–[KR6d0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0181)).
- **The Lotus liturgy: *Fǎhuá sānmèi* 法華三昧 and the *chànyí* tradition.** Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi practice from the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) is the textual base for a Sòng-period ritual literature, principally elaborated by Zūnshì and Zhīlǐ, that fed back into ordinary monastic and lay practice and shaped the late-imperial Tiāntái devotional landscape.
- **The Guānyīn 觀音 sub-cult.** The detachment of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 (Lotus chapter 25) as an independent devotional unit, with its own commentarial corpus ([KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046)–[KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057)) — Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and *yìshū* and their Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentaries — is one of the principal vehicles by which the Lotus's textual presence extended into popular ritual practice.
- **Japanese Lotus reception: Tendai 天台 and Shingon 真言 readings.** The Heian-period esoteric / *mìjiào* interpretations of the Lotus by Kūkai 空海 ([KR6d0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0036)–[KR6d0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0044)) and the early Japanese Tendai materials (e.g. [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)) constitute a distinct Lotus reading transmitted within the same division.
- **The Míng–Qīng Tiāntái revival.** Zhìxù's [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) 17th-century systematisation, the Qīng-period Tiāntái commentaries by Língyào, Tōnglǐ, and others ([KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084)–[KR6d0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0098), [KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142)), and the late-imperial *Sìjiào yí* sub-commentaries ([KR6d0169](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0169)–[KR6d0174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0174)) constitute the final phase of pre-modern Lotus scholarship represented in the division.

## Division note: [KR6d 法華部 *Fǎhuá bù* — Buddhist Canon — Saddharmapuṇḍarīka (Lotus) Section](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/)

### Scope and scholarly tradition

`KR6d` corresponds to the *Fǎhuá bù* 法華部 of the Taishō structural ordering — the Lotus Sūtra and its satellite scriptures in Taishō volume 9, the Lotus sub-commentary tradition in Taishō volumes 26 and 33–34, the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal-and-meditation corpus in Taishō volume 46, the Lotus Dūnhuáng 敦煌 fragments in volume 85, and the very large Sòng–Qīng manuscript continuation of all these strands preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏經. In Wilkinson's outline of the Taishō (§29.5.8), volume 9 is identified as "*Fǎhuá bù* (Lotus and other Mahāyāna sūtras)"; Kanripo's `KR6d` extends that vol. 9 nucleus outward to absorb all Chinese-language Lotus commentary and the entire Tiāntái scholastic apparatus that grows out of it, because in East-Asian classification the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal tradition — including its meditation manuals, doctrinal-classification literature, and ritual / *chànyí* 懺儀 works — is canonically attached to the Lotus Sūtra rather than treated as an independent *zōng* 宗 section.

The principal scholarly tradition organising the division is therefore Tiāntái, whose founder Zhìyǐ 智顗 (538–597) was traditionally regarded as the patriarch and whose 593–597 lectures at Yùquánsì 玉泉寺, redacted by Guàndǐng 灌頂 (561–632), produced the *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 ("Three Great Treatises of Tiāntái") — *Fǎhuá xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006), *Fǎhuá wénjù* [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014), and *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — around which most of the division is structured (Wilkinson §29.5.7.1 on Tiāntái; Hurvitz 1963 on Zhìyǐ; Lopez 2016 and Teiser & Stone 2009 on the Lotus Sūtra). Pre-Tiāntái Liáng exegesis (Fǎyún 法雲), the early Suí Sānlùn 三論 reading by Jízàng 吉藏, and the Táng Faxiang 法相 / Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading by Kuījī 窺基 are also represented; from the 8th century onward the division is dominated by Zhànrán 湛然 (711–782) and his Sòng-period successors of the Tiāntái revival, and from the 11th century by the long *shānjiā* / *shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy and its literature. The division extends through Yuán, Míng (with the Tiāntái revival under Zhìxù 智旭 1599–1655), and Qīng (under Língyào 靈耀 and Tōnglǐ 通理) to roughly the mid-18th century.

### Important texts and text clusters

The 249 per-text notes in `kb/KR6d/` organise into five recognisable clusters.

#### The Lotus Sūtra itself and its parallel translations

- *Zhèng fǎhuá jīng* 正法華經 [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002) — Dharmarakṣa's 竺法護 translation of 286 CE, the earliest complete Chinese Lotus, surviving in 10 *juan*.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001) — Kumārajīva's 鳩摩羅什 translation of 406 CE, the dominant East-Asian recension in 7 *juan* and 28 chapters; the literary base for virtually all subsequent Lotus exegesis in Chinese.
- *Tiānpǐn miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 添品妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003) — the Suí (601) collation by Jñānagupta 闍那崛多 and Dharmagupta 笈多, incorporating the *Devadatta* chapter and the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 verses.
- *Sàtán fēntuólì jīng* 薩曇分陀利經 [KR6d0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0004) — a Western Jìn anonymous partial translation of the *Devadatta* episode, preserving a textual stratum independent of the three full versions.

#### Satellite Lotus-cycle sūtras (vol. 9)

- *Wúliàng yì jīng* 無量義經 [KR6d0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0118) — the Liáng-period "Sūtra of Innumerable Meanings," traditionally the prologue of the East-Asian "Threefold Lotus" 法華三部經.
- *Fóshuō Guān Pǔxián púsà xíngfǎ jīng* 佛說觀普賢菩薩行法經 [KR6d0120](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0120) — the Liú-Sòng-period "Sūtra of the Contemplation of Samantabhadra's Practice," the epilogue of the same triad.
- *Fóshuō fǎhuá sānmèi jīng* 佛說法華三昧經 [KR6d0108](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0108), *Bùtuìzhuǎn fǎlún jīng* 不退轉法輪經 [KR6d0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0106), *Dà fǎgǔ jīng* 大法鼓經 [KR6d0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0109), *Dà sàzhē Nígānzǐ suǒshuō jīng* 大薩遮尼乾子所說經 [KR6d0111](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0111) — Mahāyāna sūtras grouped with the Lotus on doctrinal and thematic grounds (one-vehicle teaching, irreversibility, the Tathāgata's hidden lifespan).

#### The *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 and their commentaries

- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng xuányì* 妙法蓮華經玄義 [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006) — Zhìyǐ's 593 Yùquánsì lectures on the doctrinal meaning of the Lotus, recorded by Guàndǐng; the foundational systematic theology of Tiāntái, source for the *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng wénjù* 妙法蓮華經文句 [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014) — Zhìyǐ's 587 phrase-by-phrase commentary on Kumārajīva's Lotus, recorded by Guàndǐng; pairs with the *Xuányì* as the doctrinal-plus-textual exegetical core.
- *Móhē zhǐguān* 摩訶止觀 [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — Zhìyǐ's 594 lectures on Tiāntái meditation, recorded by Guàndǐng; the most systematic *śamatha-vipaśyanā* manual in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- *Fǎhuá xuányì shìqiān* 法華玄義釋籤 [KR6d0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0007), *Fǎhuá wénjù jì* 法華文句記 [KR6d0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0015), and *Zhǐguān fǔxíng zhuànhóngjué* 止觀輔行傳弘決 [KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131) — Zhànrán's 湛然 (711–782) standard sub-commentaries on each member of the *sāndàbù*; the principal textual base of the Sòng Tiāntái revival.

#### Alternative Lotus-commentary traditions

- *Fǎhuá jīng yìjì* 法華經義記 [KR6d0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0005) — Fǎyún's 法雲 Liáng-period exegesis, the principal southern pre-Tiāntái reading and the polemical target of Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì*.
- *Fǎhuá xuánlùn* 法華玄論 [KR6d0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0023), *Fǎhuá yìshū* 法華義疏 [KR6d0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0024), *Fǎhuá yóuyì* 法華遊意 [KR6d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0025) — Jízàng's 吉藏 (549–623) Sānlùn 三論-school readings, doctrinally distinct from Tiāntái.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng xuánzàn* 妙法蓮華經玄贊 [KR6d0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0026) — Kuījī's 窺基 (632–682) Cí'ēn 慈恩 / Yogācāra reading of the Lotus, the principal Faxiang interpretation.
- *Fǎhuá zōngyào* 法華宗要 [KR6d0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0032) — the Sillan master Wǒnhyo's 元曉 short doctrinal synthesis, an important East-Asian non-Chinese voice.

#### Tiāntái doctrinal, meditation, and ritual literature (vol. 46)

- *Sìjiào yì* 四教義 [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* 天台四教儀 [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168) — Zhìyǐ's and the late-Táng / Korean Chégwan 諦觀's expositions of the four doctrinal teachings, the most-studied Tiāntái catechetical works.
- *Shí bùèr mén* 十不二門 [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the very large body of commentary it provoked (e.g. *Shí bùèr mén zhǐyào chāo* [KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158) by Zhīlǐ 知禮) — Zhànrán's 10-fold non-duality scheme, the textual flashpoint of the *shānjiā / shānwài* controversy.
- *Jīngāngbēi* 金剛錍 [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) — Zhànrán's polemical defense of *wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性 (Buddha-nature in insentient things), generative of a sub-commentary tradition into the Sòng.
- *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* 法華三昧懺儀 [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) and the related *chànyí* / *xíngfǎ* corpus — Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi liturgy and its Sòng elaborations (Zūnshì 遵式, Zhīlǐ 知禮), the principal Tiāntái ritual texts.
- *Sìmíng zūnzhě jiàoxíng lù* 四明尊者教行錄 [KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) — Zōngxiǎo's 宗曉 collected works of Zhīlǐ, the textual monument of the Sòng *shānjiā* school.
- *Jiàoguān gāngzōng* 教觀綱宗 [KR6d0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0188) — Zhìxù's 智旭 (1599–1655) Míng-period summary of Tiāntái doctrine, the principal late-imperial textbook.

### Important persons

- [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) — translator of the standard Lotus recension (T262 = [KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)); the literary register of his translation supplied the canonical Sinitic vocabulary of all subsequent Lotus exegesis in this division.
- [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) — translator of the earliest complete Chinese Lotus (T263 = [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002), 286) and of several satellite vol. 9 sūtras; his Lotus survives as the principal philological witness independent of Kumārajīva.
- [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) — co-translator with Dharmagupta 笈多 of the Suí Lotus recension (T264 = [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003), 601), source of the textual additions to the received Kumārajīva Lotus.
- [法雲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E9%9B%B2) — Liáng-period exegete of the Lotus ([KR6d0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0005)); the standard pre-Tiāntái southern reading, against which Zhìyǐ defined his own system.
- [慧思](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%80%9D) — Tiāntái second patriarch and Zhìyǐ's teacher; author of the *Fǎhuá jīng ānlèxíng yì* [KR6d0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0156) and other proto-Tiāntái Lotus-meditation works.
- [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) — third Tiāntái patriarch and de facto founder of Chinese Tiāntái doctrine; lecturer of the *sāndàbù* and dozens of other works in this division (the most-cited person in `KR6d`, named in ≈ 25 per-text notes).
- [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) — Zhìyǐ's principal disciple and the redactor / co-author of nearly the entire Zhìyǐ corpus; also author of the *Guóqīng bǎilù* [KR6d0183](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0183), the documentary record of the early Tiāntái community.
- [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) — Sānlùn master whose Lotus commentaries ([KR6d0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0023)–[KR6d0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0025), [KR6d0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0128)) represent the principal alternative early-Suí exegetical line.
- [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) — Cí'ēn / Faxiang master who gave the Lotus a Yogācāra reading ([KR6d0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0026)); the source of the *xuánzàn* sub-commentary tradition.
- [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) — sixth Tiāntái patriarch and reviver of the school in the mid-Táng; author of the canonical sub-commentaries on the *sāndàbù* ([KR6d0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0007), [KR6d0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0015), [KR6d0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0131)) and of the doctrinally generative *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175).
- [空海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A9%BA%E6%B5%B7) — founder of Japanese Shingon and author of seven Lotus-related Heian works in this division (e.g. [KR6d0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0036)–[KR6d0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0042)), giving the Lotus its esoteric / *mìjiào* 密教 reading.
- [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) — leader of the Sòng *shānjiā* 山家 branch of Tiāntái and the dominant figure of the 11th-century revival; the second-most-cited person in `KR6d` (≈ 11 notes), with the *Shí bùèr mén zhǐyào chāo* [KR6d0158](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0158) and his liturgical *xíngfǎ* corpus.
- [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) — Zhīlǐ's contemporary and the principal Sòng ritual compiler; author of Tiāntái *chànyí* and devotional works (e.g. [KR6d0195](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0195), [KR6d0199](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0199)).
- [仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3) — Zhīlǐ's disciple who later turned to the *shānwài* 山外 position; author of the *Sìmíng Rényuè yìshuō cóngshū* [KR6d0224](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0224), the principal *shānwài* counter-statement.
- [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) — late-Sòng commentator on the *Móhē zhǐguān* and *Shí bùèr mén* whose works ([KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139)–[KR6d0141](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0141)) preserve the post-Zhīlǐ scholastic apparatus.
- [宗曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%9B%89) — Sòng compiler of the *Sìmíng zūnzhě jiàoxíng lù* [KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186), the corpus of Zhīlǐ's writings; principal documentary editor of *shānjiā* Tiāntái.
- [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) — Míng-period reviver of Tiāntái and author of the *Jiàoguān gāngzōng* [KR6d0188](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0188); the principal late-imperial systematiser whose works re-frame Tiāntái for the Míng-Qīng setting.
- [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) — Qīng-period Tiāntái commentator on the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *sāndàbù* ([KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142) and related); his work is the principal Qīng Tiāntái scholastic continuation.

### Topics

- **The ekayāna 一乘 doctrine and *kāiquán xiǎnshí* 開權顯實.** The proclamation in chapters 2–9 of the Lotus that the *śrāvaka* / *pratyekabuddha* / *bodhisattva* three vehicles are provisional (*quán* 權) and the Buddha-vehicle alone is real (*shí* 實) is the central scriptural commitment around which the entire Tiāntái doctrinal apparatus is built, and almost every Sinitic Lotus exegete from Fǎyún onward addresses its hermeneutic status.
- **The *jìmén* / *běnmén* 跡門／本門 division.** The split of the Lotus into a "trace-gate" (chapters 1–14) and an "origin-gate" (15–28) is associated with Dàoxuān's preface to Kumārajīva ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)) and given systematic articulation in Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006); it remains the standard Sinitic exegetical schema through the entire division.
- **The *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.** Zhìyǐ's chronological-and-modal organisation of the Buddha's *kerygma* into five periods (*Huāyán*, *Lùyuàn / Āhán*, *Fāngděng*, *Bōrě*, *Fǎhuá-Nièpán*) and eight modes is developed in the *Xuányì*, summarised in [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and [KR6d0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0167), and given canonical compact form in Chégwan's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168); it is the basic doctrinal-classification apparatus of the division.
- **Tiāntái meditation: *yīxīn sānguān* 一心三觀, *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千, *zhǐguān bùèr* 止觀不二.** Articulated principally in the *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) and its commentaries; the most systematic Mahāyāna meditation theory in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- **The *shānjiā / shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy.** The 11th-century Sòng-period split between Zhīlǐ's [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) "mountain-house" *shānjiā* — defending the Tiāntái doctrine of evil in the Buddha-nature (*xìng-è* 性惡) and Guàndǐng's role in the early canon — and the *shānwài* counter-position of Yuánqīng 源清, Zhìyuán 智圓, and (later) Rényuè 仁岳, particularly over the interpretation of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the status of Guàndǐng's *Guānyīn xuányì* commentary [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046). The dispute generated the large mid-Sòng polemical literature visible in [KR6d0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0184)–[KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) and [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)–[KR6d0235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0235).
- **Buddha-nature in the insentient (*wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性).** Zhànrán's claim in the *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) that even insentient things possess Buddha-nature; the Tiāntái counter-position to the Chán and Huāyán readings on the same question, generating the *Jīngāngbēi*-commentary sub-tradition ([KR6d0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0176)–[KR6d0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0181)).
- **The Lotus liturgy: *Fǎhuá sānmèi* 法華三昧 and the *chànyí* tradition.** Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi practice from the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) is the textual base for a Sòng-period ritual literature, principally elaborated by Zūnshì and Zhīlǐ, that fed back into ordinary monastic and lay practice and shaped the late-imperial Tiāntái devotional landscape.
- **The Guānyīn 觀音 sub-cult.** The detachment of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 (Lotus chapter 25) as an independent devotional unit, with its own commentarial corpus ([KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046)–[KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057)) — Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and *yìshū* and their Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentaries — is one of the principal vehicles by which the Lotus's textual presence extended into popular ritual practice.

## Division note: [KR6d 法華部 *Fǎhuá bù* — Buddhist Canon — Saddharmapuṇḍarīka (Lotus) Section](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/)

### Scope and scholarly tradition

`KR6d` corresponds to the *Fǎhuá bù* 法華部 of the Taishō structural ordering — the Lotus Sūtra and its satellite scriptures in Taishō volume 9, the Lotus sub-commentary tradition in Taishō volumes 26 and 33–34, the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal-and-meditation corpus in Taishō volume 46, the Lotus Dūnhuáng 敦煌 fragments in volume 85, and the very large Sòng–Qīng manuscript continuation of all these strands preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏經. In Wilkinson's outline of the Taishō (§29.5.8), volume 9 is identified as "*Fǎhuá bù* (Lotus and other Mahāyāna sūtras)"; Kanripo's `KR6d` extends that vol. 9 nucleus outward to absorb all Chinese-language Lotus commentary and the entire Tiāntái scholastic apparatus that grows out of it, because in East-Asian classification the Tiāntái 天台 doctrinal tradition — including its meditation manuals, doctrinal-classification literature, and ritual / *chànyí* 懺儀 works — is canonically attached to the Lotus Sūtra rather than treated as an independent *zōng* 宗 section.

The principal scholarly tradition organising the division is therefore Tiāntái, whose founder Zhìyǐ 智顗 (538–597) was traditionally regarded as the patriarch and whose 593–597 lectures at Yùquánsì 玉泉寺, redacted by Guàndǐng 灌頂 (561–632), produced the *Tiāntái sāndàbù* 天台三大部 ("Three Great Treatises of Tiāntái") — *Fǎhuá xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006), *Fǎhuá wénjù* [KR6d0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0014), and *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) — around which most of the division is structured (Wilkinson §29.5.7.1 on Tiāntái; Hurvitz 1963 on Zhìyǐ; Lopez 2016 and Teiser & Stone 2009 on the Lotus Sūtra). Pre-Tiāntái Liáng exegesis (Fǎyún 法雲), the early Suí Sānlùn 三論 reading by Jízàng 吉藏, and the Táng Faxiang 法相 / Cí'ēn 慈恩 reading by Kuījī 窺基 are also represented; from the 8th century onward the division is dominated by Zhànrán 湛然 (711–782) and his Sòng-period successors of the Tiāntái revival, and from the 11th century by the long *shānjiā* / *shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy and its literature. The division extends through Yuán, Míng (with the Tiāntái revival under Zhìxù 智旭 1599–1655), and Qīng (under Língyào 靈耀 and Tōnglǐ 通理) to roughly the mid-18th century.

### Important texts and text clusters

The 249 per-text notes in `kb/KR6d/` organise into five recognisable clusters.

#### The Lotus Sūtra itself and its parallel translations

- *Zhèng fǎhuá jīng* 正法華經 [KR6d0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0002) — Dharmarakṣa's 竺法護 translation of 286 CE, the earliest complete Chinese Lotus, surviving in 10 *juan*.
- *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001) — Kumārajīva's 鳩摩羅什 translation of 406 CE, the dominant East-Asian recension in 7 *juan* and 28 chapters; the literary base for virtually all subsequent Lotus exegesis in Chinese.
- *Tiānpǐn miàofǎ liánhuá jīng* 添品妙法蓮華經 [KR6d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0003) — the Suí (601) collation by Jñānagupta 闍那崛多 and Dharmagupta 笈多, incorporating the *Devadatta* chapter and the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 verses.
- *Sàtán fēntuólì jīng* 薩曇分陀利經 [KR6d0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0004) — a Western Jìn anonymous partial translation of the *Devadatta* episode, preserving a textual stratum independent of the three full versions.

### Topics

- **The ekayāna 一乘 doctrine and *kāiquán xiǎnshí* 開權顯實.** The proclamation in chapters 2–9 of the Lotus that the *śrāvaka* / *pratyekabuddha* / *bodhisattva* three vehicles are provisional (*quán* 權) and the Buddha-vehicle alone is real (*shí* 實) is the central scriptural commitment around which the entire Tiāntái doctrinal apparatus is built, and almost every Sinitic Lotus exegete from Fǎyún onward addresses its hermeneutic status.
- **The *jìmén* / *běnmén* 跡門／本門 division.** The split of the Lotus into a "trace-gate" (chapters 1–14) and an "origin-gate" (15–28) is associated with Dàoxuān's preface to Kumārajīva ([KR6d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0001)) and given systematic articulation in Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* [KR6d0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0006); it remains the standard Sinitic exegetical schema through the entire division.
- **The *wǔshí bājiào* 五時八教 classification.** Zhìyǐ's chronological-and-modal organisation of the Buddha's *kerygma* into five periods (*Huāyán*, *Lùyuàn / Āhán*, *Fāngděng*, *Bōrě*, *Fǎhuá-Nièpán*) and eight modes is developed in the *Xuányì*, summarised in [KR6d0166](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0166) and [KR6d0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0167), and given canonical compact form in Chégwan's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* [KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168); it is the basic doctrinal-classification apparatus of the division.
- **Tiāntái meditation: *yīxīn sānguān* 一心三觀, *yīniàn sānqiān* 一念三千, *zhǐguān bùèr* 止觀不二.** Articulated principally in the *Móhē zhǐguān* [KR6d0130](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0130) and its commentaries; the most systematic Mahāyāna meditation theory in Chinese, organised on the *shíjìng × shíchéng* 十境十乘 matrix.
- **The *shānjiā / shānwài* 山家／山外 controversy.** The 11th-century Sòng-period split between Zhīlǐ's [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE) "mountain-house" *shānjiā* — defending the Tiāntái doctrine of evil in the Buddha-nature (*xìng-è* 性惡) and Guàndǐng's role in the early canon — and the *shānwài* counter-position of Yuánqīng 源清, Zhìyuán 智圓, and (later) Rényuè 仁岳, particularly over the interpretation of Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* [KR6d0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0157) and the status of Guàndǐng's *Guānyīn xuányì* commentary [KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046). The dispute generated the large mid-Sòng polemical literature visible in [KR6d0184](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0184)–[KR6d0186](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0186) and [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)–[KR6d0235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0235).
- **Buddha-nature in the insentient (*wúqíng yǒu xìng* 無情有性).** Zhànrán's claim in the *Jīngāngbēi* [KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175) that even insentient things possess Buddha-nature; the Tiāntái counter-position to the Chán and Huāyán readings on the same question, generating the *Jīngāngbēi*-commentary sub-tradition ([KR6d0176](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0176)–[KR6d0181](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0181)).
- **The Lotus liturgy: *Fǎhuá sānmèi* 法華三昧 and the *chànyí* tradition.** Zhìyǐ's Lotus-Samādhi practice from the *Móhē zhǐguān* and the *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* [KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191) is the textual base for a Sòng-period ritual literature, principally elaborated by Zūnshì and Zhīlǐ, that fed back into ordinary monastic and lay practice and shaped the late-imperial Tiāntái devotional landscape.
- **The Guānyīn 觀音 sub-cult.** The detachment of the *Pǔmén pǐn* 普門品 (Lotus chapter 25) as an independent devotional unit, with its own commentarial corpus ([KR6d0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0046)–[KR6d0057](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0057)) — Zhìyǐ's *Guānyīn xuányì* and *yìshū* and their Sòng / Míng / Qīng commentaries — is one of the principal vehicles by which the Lotus's textual presence extended into popular ritual practice.
- **Japanese Lotus reception: Tendai 天台 and Shingon 真言 readings.** The Heian-period esoteric / *mìjiào* interpretations of the Lotus by Kūkai 空海 ([KR6d0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0036)–[KR6d0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0044)) and the early Japanese Tendai materials (e.g. [KR6d0220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0220)) constitute a distinct Lotus reading transmitted within the same division.
- **The Míng–Qīng Tiāntái revival.** Zhìxù's [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) 17th-century systematisation, the Qīng-period Tiāntái commentaries by Língyào, Tōnglǐ, and others ([KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084)–[KR6d0098](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0098), [KR6d0142](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0142)), and the late-imperial *Sìjiào yí* sub-commentaries ([KR6d0169](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0169)–[KR6d0174](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0174)) constitute the final phase of pre-modern Lotus scholarship represented in the division.

### Scope and scholarly tradition

`KR6g` is the Kanripo mirror of the Taishō *Nièpán bù* 涅槃部 — the canonical division that gathers the Mahāyāna *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* (MPNS) corpus in its full transmissional and exegetical extent. In CANWWW the division is `div19`; the Taishō core runs from `T12N0374` (Dharmakṣema's 40-fascicle Northern Recension) through `T12N0396` and is preceded in the canon's architecture by the *Bǎojī bù* 寶積部 ([KR6f](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/), `div03`). `KR6g` extends the Taishō *Nièpán bù* by absorbing the entire commentarial superstructure attached to the *Nièpán jīng* and to its short companion-text the *Yíjiào jīng* 遺教經: the *jīngshū bù* Tiāntái cluster from Taishō volumes 37–38 (T1763–T1769), the Dūnhuáng MPNS-commentary fragments from volume 85 (T2764A, T2764B, T2765), the Indian *śāstra* layer on the *Yíjiào jīng* and on the *Nièpán jīng*'s doctrinal cruxes from volume 26 (T1527–T1529), the *Yíjiàojīnglùn shū* tradition from volume 40 (T1820), the *Manji Xùzàngjīng* commentaries on the MPNS and on the *Yíjiào jīng* (X656–X666, X845–X846), and a Northern Yongle-canon witness — 52 works in total.

The chronological span runs from Dharmarakṣa's 竺法護 late-third-century Western-Jìn translations of pre-MPNS parinirvāṇa material ([KR6g0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0024) *Fāngděng bān ní huán jīng* of c. 266–313, [KR6g0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0036) *Bān ní huán hòu guàn là jīng*) through to the mid-seventeenth-century late-Ming commentary of Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 ([KR6g0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0048) *Yíjiàojīng jiě* of 1620–1655), with the active Indic-translation phase concentrated in the fifth century (Dharmakṣema, Fǎxiǎn, the Huìyán / Huìguān editorial team) and the active East-Asian commentarial phase running from the Liáng compiled commentary of Bǎoliàng 寶亮 ([KR6g0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0004) of c. 488–509) through the late-Míng synthesis. The principal transmissional traditions a reader must keep in mind are five: (i) the late-third- / early-fourth-century pre-MPNS translation lineage of Dharmarakṣa 竺法護 and Zhú Fóniàn 竺佛念 in Cháng'ān, whose short *bānníhuán* texts established the basic Chinese terminology for the Buddha's death-scene; (ii) the early-fifth-century Northern Liáng / Eastern Jìn translation lineage of Dharmakṣema 曇無讖 and Fǎxiǎn 法顯, which produced the two definitive Chinese MPNS recensions (long 40-fasc. and short 6-fasc.) within the same decade; (iii) the Liú-Sòng editorial lineage of Huìyán 慧嚴 and [慧觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E8%A7%80) Huìguān at Jiànkāng, which produced the harmonised *Southern Recension* (南本 *Nánběn*) [KR6g0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0003) that became the dominant text in southern monastic establishments; (iv) the Suí–Táng Tiāntái commentarial lineage of Guàndǐng 灌頂 ([KR6g0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0005), [KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007)) → Dàoxiān 道暹 / Xíngmǎn 行滿 ([KR6g0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0017)–[KR6g0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0018)) → Zhànrán 湛然 ([KR6g0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0016)) → Zhìyuán 智圓 ([KR6g0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0006), [KR6g0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0014), [KR6g0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0019)), which constituted the canonical scholastic apparatus on the *Nièpán jīng*; and (v) the Sòng–Míng *Yíjiào jīng* commentarial tradition of Jìngyuán 淨源, Shǒusuì 守遂, Yuánzhào 元照, Guānfù 觀復 and Zhìxù 智旭, which made Kumārajīva's [KR6g0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0043) one-fascicle *Yíjiào jīng* one of the most-commented short Buddhist texts in East Asia. The division is therefore the principal canonical arena for the Mahāyāna *tathāgatagarbha* / Buddha-nature (*fóxìng* 佛性) doctrine and for the literature of the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa* in all its scriptural, narrative and ritual dimensions.

### Important texts and text clusters

#### The Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra and its recensions

- *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 [KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001) — Dharmakṣema 曇無讖's 40-fascicle ***Northern Recension*** (*Běiběn* 北本, T0374, 414–421); the great Mahāyāna *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* and the principal scriptural source for the doctrine of universal Buddha-nature (*fóxìng* 佛性), including the controversial inclusion of *icchantikas* (一闡提 *yīchǎntí*). Together with the *Avataṃsaka* ([KR6e0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0001)) and the *Lotus*, it is one of the three foundational *yuánjiào* / "complete teaching" sūtras of East Asian Mahāyāna.
- *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 (*Southern Recension*) [KR6g0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0003) — Huìyán 慧嚴, [慧觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E8%A7%80) Huìguān *et al.*'s 36-fascicle ***Southern Recension*** (*Nánběn* 南本, T0375, 433–443); the Liú-Sòng editorial revision of Dharmakṣema's text, harmonised with Fǎxiǎn / Buddhabhadra's earlier short translation and re-divided into 25 chapters. The *Nánběn* / *Běiběn* doublet became the canonical East-Asian MPNS corpus, with the *Nánběn* preferred in the south and the *Běiběn* in the north.
- *Fó shuō dà bān ní huán jīng* 佛說大般泥洹經 [KR6g0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0022) — Fǎxiǎn 法顯's 6-fascicle ***short / pre-MPNS recension*** (T0376, 416–418), brought back from India by Fǎxiǎn on his great pilgrimage and translated in collaboration with Buddhabhadra at the Dàochǎngsì 道場寺 in Jiànkāng. Predating the full Dharmakṣema translation by a few years, it was the textual basis for Dàoshēng 道生's pre-emptive *Buddha-nature* doctrinal stance.
- *Dà bān niè pán jīng hòu fēn* 大般涅槃經後分 [KR6g0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0023) — Jñānabhadra 若那跋陀羅's 2-fascicle ***Latter Section*** (T0377, 660–700); the Táng supplementary continuation of the MPNS narrating the Buddha's actual *parinirvāṇa* and post-cremation events, the canonical capstone of the corpus.
- *Fó shuō fāngděng bān ní huán jīng* 佛說方等般泥洹經 [KR6g0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0024) (Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, W. Jìn) and *Bān ní huán hòu guàn là jīng* 般泥洹後灌臘經 [KR6g0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0036) (Dharmarakṣa) — the **earliest Chinese parinirvāṇa material**, predating the full MPNS tradition; provide the basic vocabulary (*bān ní huán* 般泥洹 / *bān niè pán* 般涅槃) and the ritual frame (*guàn là* — ablution-and-sacrifice) for the later corpus.

#### Major MPNS commentaries (Taishō *jīngshū bù*)

- *Dà bān niè pán jīng jí jiě* 大般涅槃經集解 [KR6g0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0004) — Bǎoliàng 寶亮 *et al.*'s 71-fascicle Liáng-period **compiled commentary** (T1763, c. 488–509), gathering the work of multiple Nièpán-school authorities into a single comprehensive apparatus; one of the largest single commentaries in pre-Táng Chinese Buddhism.
- *Dà bān niè pán jīng yì jì* 大般涅槃經義記 [KR6g0002](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0002) — Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn 淨影慧遠's 10-fascicle Suí commentary (T1764, 580–592); the foundational *Dìlùn*-school reading and one of the principal Suí scholastic statements of Buddha-nature doctrine.
- **Tiāntái MPNS commentaries by Guàndǐng 灌頂** — [KR6g0005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0005) *Xuán yì* 玄義 (2 fasc., T1765, doctrinal preamble) and [KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007) *Shū* 疏 (33 fasc., T1767, full sectional commentary) of c. 597–632; the canonical Tiāntái apparatus on the *Nièpán jīng*, paralleling Zhìyǐ's *Xuányì* / *Wénjù* / *Zhǐguān* triad on the *Lotus*.
- *Niè pán jīng yóu yì* 涅槃經遊意 [KR6g0008](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0008) — Jízàng 吉藏's 1-fascicle Sānlùn-school "roving reflections" (T1768, 595–623); the Sānlùn alternative to the Tiāntái synthesis.
- *Niè pán zōng yào* 涅槃宗要 [KR6g0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0009) — Wǒnhyo 元曉's Sillan compendium on the doctrinal essence of the MPNS (T1769, 660–686); paralleling his [KR6f0067](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0067) *Zōngyào* on the *Larger Sukhāvatī*.
- *Niè pán xuán yì fā yuán jī yào* 涅槃玄義發源機要 [KR6g0006](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0006) — Zhìyuán 智圓's Northern-Sòng sub-commentary on Guàndǐng's *Xuán yì* (T1766, 990–1022); the Sòng *Shānwài* 山外 Tiāntái reading.
- **Dūnhuáng MPNS-commentary fragments** — [KR6g0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0010) *Nièpánjīng yì jì* (T2764A), [KR6g0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0011) *Dànièpánjīng yì jì juàn dì sì* (T2764B), [KR6g0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0012) *Nièpánjīng shū* (T2765); the Táng-period anonymous Dūnhuáng witnesses to the otherwise-lost early MPNS-commentary tradition.

#### MPNS commentaries in the *Manji Xùzàngjīng*

- *Niè pán jīng huìshū* 涅槃經會疏 [KR6g0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0016) — the 36-fascicle composite "combined commentary" assembling Guàndǐng's *Shū* with Zhànrán's 湛然 Táng editorial revision and [本純](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E7%B4%94) Honjun's Edo-Japanese editorial *fēn huì* (X659); the standard Japanese-Tendai working text on the MPNS. Its prolegomenon [KR6g0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0013) *Xuán yì wén jù* (X656) and its outline [KR6g0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0015) *Tiáo gě* (X658) form a single editorial complex.
- **Sòng Tiāntái sub-commentaries on Guàndǐng's *Shū*** — [KR6g0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0014) *Zhìdìng shū kē* 治定疏科 (10 fasc., X657, structural outline), [KR6g0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0019) *Sān dé zhǐ guī* 三德指歸 (19 fasc., X662, doctrinal sub-commentary) — both by Zhìyuán 智圓 of the Northern Sòng. Together they constitute the great *Shānwài*-school 山外 apparatus on the MPNS-commentary tradition.
- **Táng Tiāntái sub-commentaries (*sījì* 私記)** — [KR6g0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0017) *Sījì* of Xíngmǎn 行滿 (12 fasc., X660) and [KR6g0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0018) *Sījì* of Dàoxiān 道暹 (9 fasc., X661); the mid-Táng sub-commentarial layer between Guàndǐng and Zhànrán.
- **Yuán editorial works on the *Nánběn*** — [KR6g0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0020) *Kē Nánběn Nièpánjīng* 科南本涅槃經 ([師正](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%AD%A3) Shīzhèng, X663) and [KR6g0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0021) *Nièpán jīng huìshū jiě* 涅槃經會疏解 (Shīzhèng + [圓澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%BE%84) Yuánchéng, X664); structural-outline and explication of the Southern Recension and its commentary tradition.

#### Related Mahāyāna sūtras (T12 0379–0388)

The Taishō editors grouped a cluster of independent Mahāyāna sūtras around the MPNS on grounds of doctrinal and narrative affinity — *samādhi*-doctrine, Mahāmāyā / Buddha-mother literature, *mòfǎ* prophecy, *antarābhava* (intermediate state):

- *Sì tóng zǐ sānmèi jīng* 四童子三昧經 [KR6g0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0025) — Jñānagupta 闍那崛多 (Suí, T0379), Mahāyāna *samādhi*-sūtra.
- *Dà bēi jīng* 大悲經 [KR6g0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0026) — Narendrayaśas 那連提耶舍 (N. Qí, T0380), the *Karuṇāpuṇḍarīka-sūtra*.
- *Děng jí zhòng dé sānmèi jīng* 等集眾德三昧經 [KR6g0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0027) — Dharmarakṣa (W. Jìn, T0381), another *samādhi* sūtra; paralleled by [KR6g0028](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0028) *Jí yīqiè fúdé sānmèi jīng* (Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, Yáo-Qín, T0382, *Sarvapuṇya-samuccaya-samādhi*).
- *Mó hē mó yē jīng* 摩訶摩耶經 [KR6g0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0029) — Tánjǐng 曇景 (Xiāo-Qí, T0383), the *Mahāmāyā-sūtra* narrating the Buddha's parinirvāṇa from the perspective of his mother Mahā-māyā in the Trāyastriṃśa heaven; contains the standard *mòfǎ* 末法 prophecy of the decline of the Dharma.
- *Púsà cóng dōushùtiān jiàng shén mǔtāi shuō guǎng pǔ jīng* 菩薩從兜術天降神母胎說廣普經 [KR6g0030](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0030) — Zhú Fóniàn 竺佛念 (Yáo-Qín, T0384), the "descent from Tuṣita" sūtra. Paralleled by [KR6g0031](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0031) *Zhōng yīn jīng* 中陰經 (Zhú Fóniàn, T0385), the principal Chinese sūtra on the *antarābhava* / intermediate state.
- *Lián huā miàn jīng* 蓮華面經 [KR6g0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0032) — Narendrayaśas (Suí, T0386), prophecy of the destruction of the Dharma by King Mihirakula.
- *Dà fāngděng wúxiǎng jīng* 大方等無想經 [KR6g0033](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0033) — Dharmakṣema (N. Liáng, T0387) — the famous *Dà yún jīng* 大雲經 / *Mahāmegha-sūtra*, politically consequential in Táng history: a re-translation / forgery of it was used by Empress [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān in 690 to justify her usurpation, on the basis that the *Dà yún jīng* prophesies the appearance of a female cakravartin queen. Followed by the fragmentary [KR6g0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0034) *Dà yún wú xiǎng jīng juàn dì jiǔ* (T0388).

#### Buddha-parinirvāṇa narrative and ritual short sūtras (T390–T396)

A cluster of short anonymous and attributed sūtras transmitting the narrative and ritual surround of the Buddha's death-scene; the textual basis for monastic memorial liturgy:

- *Fó lín niè pán jì fǎ zhù jīng* 佛臨涅槃記法住經 [KR6g0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0035) — Xuánzàng 玄奘 (Táng, T0390); on the *abiding of the Dharma* (*fǎ zhù*) after the Buddha's death.
- *Fó miè dù hòu guān liǎn zàng sòng jīng* 佛滅度後棺斂葬送經 [KR6g0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0037) (anonymous, T0392) — on the coffining, cremation and funeral.
- *Jiāyè fù fó bān niè pán jīng* 迦葉赴佛般涅槃經 [KR6g0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0038) — Zhú Tánwúlán 竺曇無蘭 (E. Jìn, T0393), Mahākāśyapa's hastening to the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa*.
- *Fó rù niè pán mìjì jīngāng lìshì āiliàn jīng* 佛入涅槃密迹金剛力士哀戀經 [KR6g0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0039) (anonymous, T0394) — Vajrapāṇi's lamentation.
- *Fó shuō dāng lái biàn jīng* 佛說當來變經 [KR6g0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0040) — Dharmarakṣa (W. Jìn, T0395), prophecy of coming changes.
- *Fó shuō fǎ miè jìn jīng* 佛說法滅盡經 [KR6g0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0041) (anonymous, T0396) — prophecy of the extinction of the Dharma; together with [KR6g0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0029) and [KR6g0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0032) one of the principal *mòfǎ* scriptural sources.
- *Fó shuō jiù hù shēn mìng jīng* 佛說救護身命經 [KR6g0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0042) — [比丘道真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AF%94%E4%B8%98%E9%81%93%E7%9C%9F) Bǐqiū Dàozhēn (Fángshān 房山 *Shíjīng*) — a Fángshān stone-canon witness to a protective-incantation text grouped here on narrative grounds.

#### The *Yíjiào jīng* cluster

The *Yíjiào jīng* 遺教經 — Kumārajīva's one-fascicle rendering of the Buddha's last admonition — is the single most-chanted short Buddhist text in East Asian monastic life, and the principal site of *vinaya*-themed exhortation outside the *Vinaya-piṭaka* proper:

- *Fó chuí bān niè pán lüè shuō jiào jiè jīng* 佛垂般涅槃略說教誡經 [KR6g0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0043) — Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (Yáo-Qín, T0389, 402–412); the foundational *Yíjiào jīng*. The Buddha's final disciplinary admonition delivered immediately before *parinirvāṇa*, gathering the essential instructions for the *saṅgha*.
- *Yíjiào jīng lùn* 遺教經論 [KR6g0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0044) — Vasubandhu 天親 / Paramārtha 真諦 (Chén, T1529, 557–569); the Indian *śāstra*-commentary on the *Yíjiào jīng*.
- **Sòng–Míng *Yíjiàojīnglùn* commentaries** — [KR6g0045](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0045) Jìngyuán 淨源's *Lùn shū jié yào* 論疏節要 (T1820) with [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Zhūhóng's Míng supplementary annotation; [KR6g0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0046) Jìngyuán's Yongle-canon recension of the same work; [KR6g0049](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0049) Yuánzhào 元照's *Zhù fǎ jì* 住法記 (X845); [KR6g0050](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0050) Guānfù 觀復's *Lùn jì* 論記 (X846). Together they constitute the Sòng-period *Yíjiàojīnglùn* sub-commentarial corpus.
- **Sòng–Míng commentaries on the *Yíjiào jīng* itself** — [KR6g0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0047) *Bǔ zhù* 補註 of Shǒusuì 守遂 with Liǎotóng 了童's Míng supplementary annotation (X665); [KR6g0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0048) *Yíjiào jīng jiě* 遺教經解 of Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 (X666, 1620–1655), the canonical late-Míng commentary by one of the *Four Great Masters of the Late Míng*.

#### *Śāstras* on the *Nièpán jīng* doctrine

- *Niè pán lùn* 涅槃論 [KR6g0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0051) — Vasubandhu 婆藪槃豆 / Dharmabodhi 達磨菩提 (N. Wèi, T1527, 508–535); the Indian *Nirvāṇa-śāstra* on Mahāyāna *parinirvāṇa* doctrine.
- *Niè pán jīng běn yǒu jīn wú jì lùn* 涅槃經本有今無偈論 [KR6g0052](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0052) — Vasubandhu / Paramārtha (Chén, T1528, 557–569); the Indian commentary on the famous *běn yǒu jīn wú* 本有今無 ("originally existed, now non-existent") verse of the MPNS, doctrinally central to mature Buddha-nature theology.

### Important persons
